def runs(grid):
 w=len(grid[0]); active=[any(row[c] for row in grid) for c in range(w)]
 out=[]; i=0
 while i<w:
  if not active[i]: i+=1; continue
  j=i
  while j+1<w and active[j+1]: j+=1
  out.append((i,j)); i=j+1
 return out
def comps(grid):
 res=[]
 for a,b in runs(grid):
  rr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row[c] for c in range(a,b+1))]
  top,bot=min(rr),max(rr)
  res.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(a,b+1)] for r in range(top,bot+1)])
 return res
def diff_transform(grid):
 cs=comps(grid)
 if len(cs)<2: return []
 a,b=cs[:2]
 if len(a[0])!=len(b[0]): return []
 out=[]
 for ra,rb in zip(a,b):
  row=[8 if x!=y else 0 for x,y in zip(ra,rb)]
  if any(row): out.append(row)
 return out
for i,(g,o) in enumerate(examples,1):

src='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])

    bands = []
    col = 0
    while col < width:
        if not any(grid[row][col] for row in range(height)):
            col += 1
            continue
        start = col
        while col + 1 < width and any(grid[row][col + 1] for row in range(height)):
            col += 1
        bands.append((start, col))
        col += 1

    patterns = []
    for left, right in bands[:2]:
        rows = [r for r in range(height) if any(grid[r][c] for c in range(left, right + 1))]
        top, bottom = rows[0], rows[-1]
        patterns.append([[grid[r][c] for c in range(left, right + 1)]
                         for r in range(top, bottom + 1)])

    first, second = patterns
    result = []
    for row_a, row_b in zip(first, second):
        diff = [8 if a != b else 0 for a, b in zip(row_a, row_b)]
        if any(diff):
            result.append(diff)
    return result
'''
